workflow_run on the stage wrappers. It inspects runs of this repository's own workflows and checks out no code from the triggering run; the workflow-level token is permissions: {} and the WING_COMMANDER_WATCHDOG_PAUSED kill switch gates every job.

workflow_run on the watchdog itself, to verify its run. It reads run metadata only and checks out no code from the triggering run; the workflow-level token is permissions: {} and the WING_COMMANDER_WATCHDOG_PAUSED kill switch gates the job.

issue_comment and pull_request_review events drive PR conversation. Bot authors are skipped in the wrapper, and the stage acts only when the commenter's author_association passes its FR-019 check; the workflow-level token is permissions: {}.

workflow_run on the implement wrapper. The job runs only when that run was cancelled, re-dispatches it at most once and checks out no code from the triggering run; the workflow-level token is permissions: {}.

issue_comment resumes a Spec Kit update question. A comment is acted on only on a non-PR issue carrying the auto-update:tracking label or marker, from a non-bot commenter the stage verifies as OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR or the issue's author; the workflow-level token is permissions: {} and WING_COMMANDER_AUTO_UPDATE_SPEC_KIT_PAUSED stops it.

workflow_run on the stage wrappers, to record each run's metrics. It reads run metadata and artifacts as data and checks out no code from the triggering run; the workflow-level token is permissions: {} and WING_COMMANDER_METRICS_PAUSED stops it.
